facts.text: In-state undergraduate tuition at West Chester University was frozen for seven consecutive years through the 2024-2025 academic year under PASSHE system decisions.

sources.title: Seventh Consecutive Year for No Tuition Increase at WCU
sources.quote: voted unanimously to freeze tuition for in-state undergraduate students for the 2024-2025 academic year. Governor Shapiro and the General Assembly played a critical role in a decision that enables the tuition rate for all 10 of PASSHE's universities to remain the same.
